t: A photo database of family homes around the world, sorted by monthly income.
steps: Open the Dollar Street site from Gapminder in a web browser.
Browse the photos by country, income, and topic.
Pick one topic such as homes or kitchens and compare a low income family with a high income family.
Read the Gapminder lesson called Living conditions on four income levels.
Try the Federal Reserve lesson called Living on Dollar Street for a middle school class.
Preview the photos before class. Students will see images of real families.
Ask students to cite the family and country for every photo they use.
